heroHeadline: Day 4,737: 'SWIM' Ties 'Dynamite' Chart Record; ARMY Asia-Australia Presale Opens; iHeartRadio Festival Confirmed
heroSubtitle: June 2, 2026 is Day 4,737 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Billboard's June 6 chart issue — published June 2 — confirms 'SWIM' has spent its 8th consecutive week at No. 1 on the Billboard Global (Excl. US) chart, tying 'Dynamite' (2020) for BTS's longest-ever No. 1 run on that chart (41.8M streams, 2K sales outside the US for May 22–28 tracking week). SWIM is now in its 11th consecutive charting week on the Hot 100 (No. 55) — an all-time K-pop longevity record on that chart. On the tour front, Big Hit Music opened the ARMY MEMBERSHIP presale for the Asia and Australia legs today (June 2) via Weverse: Kaohsiung (Taiwan) at 12pm local time; Melbourne and Sydney from 1pm AEST through June 4, with general on-sale on June 4. The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival lineup was announced June 2, confirming BTS as headliners at T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas on September 18–19 alongside Cardi B, Zara Larsson, and Benson Boone — BTS's second Las Vegas stadium/arena appearance in 2026 following the Allegiant Stadium residency. BTS FESTA 2026 continues: the 13th debut anniversary countdown is now on Day 2 of the two-week celebration (June 12–13 Busan Asiad Main Stadium concerts; June 13 global cinema live viewing via Trafalgar Releasing, 10 days away).
